exposure: Umbilical artery Doppler flow status (absent or reversed end-diastolic flow [AREDF] vs. positive end-diastolic Doppler flow [PEDF])
outcome: Time interval from admission to delivery

Composite adverse neonatal outcome (infant respiratory distress syndrome, sepsis, bronchopulmonary dysplasia, necrotizing enterocolitis, intraventricular hemorrhage >grade 2, periventricular leukomalacia, perinatal death)
cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies admitted with early-onset fetal growth restriction between 2004-2015.
finding: Fetal distress was more frequently observed in the AREDF group, leading to delivery at an earlier stage of gestation, but AREDF was not associated with increased perinatal morbidity and mortality compared with PEDF.
gest_age: Early-onset fetal growth restriction (with a subgroup analysis of patients admitted between 26 and 28 weeks' gestation)
